scope: native CI timing and cache observations

definitions.wall_s: Exact attempt API run_started_at to last exact-attempt job completion, including scheduling and downstream qualification.
definitions.created_to_last_job_s: Exact-attempt API created_at to last job completion; initial runs match wall_s; rerun API timestamps can differ.
definitions.aggregate_job_s: Sum of exact-attempt started_at-to-completed_at job durations; excludes job queue time.
definitions.stage_seconds: Timing helper elapsed whole seconds for actual Cargo test, Clippy or release commands; tests include compilation.
definitions.cache_action_costs: Actions API step elapsed seconds; post includes pruning/cleanup/archive work and any upload.
definitions.cargo_counts: Complete numeric harness summary tuples, counting executions across lanes; identical repeated summaries remain separate.
definitions.cargo_durations: Independently observed finished-in durations; interleaved fragments do not receive invented status or duration.
definitions.cache_bytes: Compressed archive sizes reported by repository cache inventory; decimal 7GB=7,000,000,000 bytes.

limitations: Selected observations, not an exhaustive history of dispatched runs; the initial full-target cache trial is documented separately and omitted from these samples.
One observation per listed attempt; no percentile or statistically established speedup.
Hosted image rollover can change environment hashes and cause cache misses.
Historical combined baseline did not emit timing-helper/cache events; unavailable observations remain absent/null.
Cache identities are matched using full keys and exact archive sizes; no inference from abbreviated hash alone.
Public release qualification and streaming matrix validation are separate evidence.
